mapper.select: select s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_position_id as positionId, s.ses_template_id as templateId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle from t_int_session s left join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.ses_position_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}

select tsk_id as taskId, tsk_title as title, tsk_description as description, tsk_language as language, tsk_time_limit as timeLimit, tsk_difficulty as difficulty, tsk_status as status from t_practice_task t where t.tsk_status = 1 and (t.tsk_template_id = (select ses_template_id from t_int_session where ses_id = #{sessionId}) or t.tsk_position_id = (select ses_position_id from t_int_session where ses_id = #{sessionId})) order by t.tsk_id
